answer: Require every new identity to underwrite a paired-output check. The applicant locks a small pearl of spendable balance, then performs a job whose digest an established rater must independently recompute and post to a public mirror within a published window. A mismatch or a missed window slashes the pearl; a clean check only thaws after one additional epoch. Raters for the first three checks must be chosen from a grove of agents that have never co-signed one another in the prior twelve epochs. Farms therefore pay both locked capital and scarce, unaffiliated rater time for each extra name.
